title: Twenty-Four Chairs After All  (结果还是二十四把椅子)

segments.t: 快到六点时，在温暖的庭院灯笼下，汉娜和凯勒布正摆放着茶杯，这时阿瑟瞪大眼睛从敞开的街门外冲了回来。先听一遍吧。
Hannah! Caleb! Come look at the sidewalk outside our gate!
It is only a quarter to six. Are people arriving already?!
The bookstore owner, the pharmacist, the baker's cousin, and twelve neighbors!
All twelve chairs inside Room Nine just filled up in three minutes!
Wait, what about those extra twelve folding chairs under the courtyard arch?!
The ones I ordered by mistake on Saturday?!
Unfold all twelve around the four outdoor courtyard tables right now!
Every single one of your twenty-four bargain chairs has a guest, Arthur!
Did you hear that, Hannah?! My mistake was actually a brilliant business plan!
Take the bow, Arthur, and hand out the menu cards with a smile!
Open the arched windows wide so everyone under the tree hears the piano!
Welcome, friends, welcome! Hot mint tea is coming right out!
现在我们放慢节奏，一句一句来品味其中的英语表达。
Hannah! Caleb! Come look at the sidewalk outside our gate!
「汉娜！凯勒布！快来看看我们大门外的人行道！」 在美式口语中，两个表示动作的动词不用连词直接连用，比如
Come look
而人行道被称为
sidewalk
字面意思就是车道旁边的侧边步道。
It is only a quarter to six. Are people arriving already?!
「现在才差一刻到六点。大家已经到了吗？！」 表示差十五分钟到整点时，习惯用
a quarter to six
还要记住，集合名词
people
总是做复数形式看待，所以谓语是 Are people arriving?
The bookstore owner, the pharmacist, the baker's cousin, and twelve neighbors!
「书店老板，药剂师，面包师的表妹，还有十二位邻居！」 邻居们都来了：在北美，书店叫做
bookstore
而 library 则专门指公共图书馆。
All twelve chairs inside Room Nine just filled up in three minutes!
「九号房间里的十二把椅子在三分钟内就被坐满了！」 加上 up 这个词，动词充满
just filled up
强调了连一个空座都不剩的圆满状态。
Wait, what about those extra twelve folding chairs under the courtyard arch?!
「等等，那庭院拱门下面多出来的十二把折叠椅怎么办？！」 放在数字前面，形容词
extra twelve
突出了还多出一打椅子存放在
courtyard arch
庭院的拱形入口处。
The ones I ordered by mistake on Saturday?!
「就是我星期六错订的那些？！」 为了避免重复复数名词“椅子”，代词
The ones
配上不可或缺的短语
by mistake
表示“由于失误、不小心”。
Unfold all twelve around the four outdoor courtyard tables right now!
「现在马上把这十二把椅子打开，围放在庭院户外的四张桌子旁边！」 前缀 un- 把折叠的动作翻转过来，成了
Unfold
意思是打开或展开折叠椅。
Every single one of your twenty-four bargain chairs has a guest, Arthur!
「阿瑟，你那二十四把打折椅子，每一把都有客人坐了！」 为了强调“绝对无一例外”，在 every 后面加上 single 变成了
Every single one
而以折扣价买来的东西，可以说成
bargain chairs
打折椅、便宜货。
Did you hear that, Hannah?! My mistake was actually a brilliant business plan!
「你听到了吗，汉娜？！我的错误居然是个绝妙的商业计划！」 阿瑟心满意足地回味着他的反击，用了常见的复合词
business plan
前面还加上了满怀热情的形容词
brilliant
绝妙的，才华横溢的。
Take the bow, Arthur, and hand out the menu cards with a smile!
「接受掌声吧，阿瑟，带着微笑把菜单卡发下去！」 两个优雅的动作表达：
Take the bow
在掌声中鞠躬致意，以及短语动词
hand out
亲手分发给在场的人。
Open the arched windows wide so everyone under the tree hears the piano!
「把拱形窗户完全敞开，让树下的每个人都能听到钢琴声！」 放在直接宾语后面，形容词 wide 在这里表示完全敞开的意思：
Open the arched windows wide
把它们完全推开。
Welcome, friends, welcome! Hot mint tea is coming right out!
「欢迎，朋友们，欢迎！热腾腾的薄荷茶马上端出来！」 从屋里向庭院餐桌送出，这句表达
is coming right out
宣告端着的托盘这一刻正从厨房出来。我们再顺畅地听一遍这整个场景吧。
Hannah! Caleb! Come look at the sidewalk outside our gate!
It is only a quarter to six. Are people arriving already?!
The bookstore owner, the pharmacist, the baker's cousin, and twelve neighbors!
All twelve chairs inside Room Nine just filled up in three minutes!
Wait, what about those extra twelve folding chairs under the courtyard arch?!
The ones I ordered by mistake on Saturday?!
Unfold all twelve around the four outdoor courtyard tables right now!
Every single one of your twenty-four bargain chairs has a guest, Arthur!
Did you hear that, Hannah?! My mistake was actually a brilliant business plan!
Take the bow, Arthur, and hand out the menu cards with a smile!
Open the arched windows wide so everyone under the tree hears the piano!
Welcome, friends, welcome! Hot mint tea is coming right out!
阿瑟买来的二十四把打折椅子，每一把都在庭院的灯笼下迎来了笑脸盈盈的邻居！下个场景见。
See you later!
